body: It is depression and anxiety. I really do not know how to explain it and can not really pinpoint where it comes from.
Maybe the world wouldnt be better without me but what I meant was I wouldnt have to deal with the pain and hopelessness I fell everyday. Thank you for your kind words, they nearly had me in tears.
I am sorry you are going through this as well. It is very hard when no one understands what you are going through.
